repository_creation_status: Nine separate public project pages created and verified; eight executable standalone implementations and one review index.

repositories.name: gold-vs-equities-india
repositories.description: INR-based asset comparison, drawdowns, rolling returns and gold-equity allocation analysis with reproducible synthetic examples.
repositories.public_edition: Reconstructed Python implementation with synthetic demonstration data and outputs.

repositories.name: econometrics-research-toolkit
repositories.description: Reusable OLS specification comparisons, HC3 inference, VIF diagnostics and research reporting, demonstrated on synthetic data.
repositories.public_edition: New public reconstruction using synthetic data; institutional research records and unpublished findings excluded.

repositories.name: derivatives-and-portfolio-risk-lab
repositories.description: European option pricing, implied volatility, numerical valuation and hedging payoffs with independently checked illustrative scenarios.
repositories.public_edition: New reconstruction of the core valuation and payoff methods using illustrative inputs.

repositories.name: digital-payments-choice-experiment
repositories.description: Synthetic demonstration of payment defaults, linear probability models, logistic regression and average discrete changes.
repositories.public_edition: Tested synthetic implementation plus three original scripts and eight historical aggregate result tables; participant inputs excluded.

repositories.name: bharat-fx
repositories.description: External-sector accounting, vintage selection, relative stress diagnostics and conditional reserve scenarios with a synthetic public demo.
repositories.public_edition: New runnable synthetic methods demonstration and detailed research-scope documentation. Original archive remains separate.

repositories.name: india-external-sector-forecasting
repositories.description: Component-coherent current-account and reserve-flow forecasts with seasonal-naive, AR1 and ridge-VAR comparisons on synthetic data.
repositories.public_edition: New synthetic forecasting demonstration, distinct from the original MAAKRO code, data and reports.

repositories.name: arma-student-t-simulation
repositories.description: ARMA(1,1) simulation with variance-normalised Student-t shocks, analytical moments, Monte Carlo diagnostics and MATLAB companion scripts.
repositories.public_edition: New executable Python reference and reconstructed MATLAB companion scripts. Original local source files were not recovered.

repositories.name: lstm-time-series-lab
repositories.description: A NumPy LSTM with checked backpropagation, chronological validation, simple forecasting baselines and a synthetic cost-aware trading illustration.
repositories.public_edition: New NumPy implementation with synthetic returns, verified gradients, chronological splits and benchmark reporting.

repositories.name: behavioural-recessions-review
repositories.description: Full narrative review of household saving, consumption and financial risk-taking during recessions, with archived aggregate data and reproducible figures.
repositories.public_edition: Research index linking the full public manuscript, figures and executable appendix in My-Projects.
